title: Version Checker not working on clean install of 3.2.0.4
symptom: After installing AAPS 3.2.0.4 on a backup phone, the user was unable to get off LGS (likely low glucose suspend) and noticed Version Checker indicating an old version. The issue also occurred on a clean master build of 3.2.0.4 on a different phone.
cause: The issue seems to be isolated to a single preferences file used as a backup; when imported, it breaks the loop, but a newer preferences file allows closing the loop.
fix: Upgrade to the latest version of AAPS, as 3.2 is no longer supported. Alternatively, use a newer preferences file instead of the old one.
evidence_quote: the issue seems to be isolated to a single preferences file I was using as a backup. When I use a newer preferences file it allows me to close the loop but the older file, when imported, breaks it again.
